declared_limits: Reference levels are heights from the underbust line, not a fit recommendation and not a size.
The figure on the source sheets is not this avatar; only the protocol transfers, never a dimension.
That the black 0 line is the underbust line is an interpretation of an unlabelled mark, evidenced by the trace and recorded here so it can be corrected in one field.
A level's girth is a body dimension with no compression allowance, like every other girth in this project.
Levels are not POMs: no house code, no tolerance, no POM sheet row, no evidence in measurements.json.
